sources.snippet: Chronos-2: Our latest model with significantly enhanced capabilities. It offers zero-shot support for univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed forecasting tasks.

sources.title: Introducing Chronos-2: From univariate to universal forecasting
sources.snippet: To address this limitation, we are introducing Chronos-2, a foundation model designed to handle arbitrary forecasting tasks — univariate, multivariate, and covariate informed — in a zero-shot manner. Chronos-2 leverages in-context learning (ICL) to enable these capabilities without additional training.
